scenes.vo_text: Panel surya nggak butuh panas. Yang dia butuh: cahaya.
scenes.visual: Textcard (f): BUKAN PANAS. from frame 1; CAHAYA. appears at the word 'cahaya'
fact_refs: A PV cell converts light directly into electricity by the photovoltaic effect

scenes.vo_text: Sel surya mengubah energi cahaya langsung jadi listrik lewat efek fotovoltaik. Cahaya yang diserap sel melepaskan elektron di sambungan p-n, dan aliran elektron itulah listriknya.
scenes.visual: (a) panel close-up; photon arrows hit the cell; electrons move through the p-n junction; + and - terminals light up.
fact_refs: A PV cell converts light directly into electricity by the photovoltaic effect
Light frees electron-hole pairs at a p-n junction (mechanism)

scenes.vo_text: Kalau yang mengubah sinar matahari jadi panas, itu alat yang berbeda: solar thermal collector.
scenes.on_screen_text: PANEL SURYA: CAHAYA -> LISTRIK / SOLAR THERMAL COLLECTOR: PANAS
scenes.visual: (b) contrast card: left 'cahaya -> listrik' (panel surya), right 'panas -> solar thermal collector'; the right side is dimmed as the VO says it is a different device.
fact_refs: Cell output is heat-driven: NOT supported. The mechanism is light; heat is a loss factor

scenes.vo_text: Listrik dari panel itu arus searah, atau DC. Untuk diubah ke AC, sering dipakai inverter.
scenes.visual: (c) DC symbol (straight line and dashed line) on the panel output; a short inverter box appears at the cue 'inverter'.
fact_refs: Output is DC; an inverter is needed to supply AC loads

scenes.vo_text: Ambil satu panel sebagai contoh: dua belas volt, lima ampere. Disambung seri, tegangannya dijumlah. Dua panel jadi dua puluh empat volt, arusnya tetap lima ampere.
scenes.on_screen_text: ANGKA CONTOH: 12 V 5 A -> 2 PANEL SERI: 24 V 5 A
scenes.visual: (d) series wiring animation: two panels joined end to end; a voltage counter adds 12 V + 12 V; current meter stays at 5 A.

numbers.derive: illustrative example panel set by PRD-20 (label ANGKA CONTOH); not a datasheet value
illustrative example panel set by PRD-20 (label ANGKA CONTOH)
arithmetic: 2 x 12 V = 24 V in series

fact_refs: Series adds voltage, parallel adds current

scenes.vo_text: Kalau tiga panel disambung paralel, arusnya yang dijumlah. Tegangannya tetap dua belas volt, arusnya jadi lima belas ampere.
scenes.visual: (e) parallel wiring animation: three panels joined side by side; a current counter adds 5 A + 5 A + 5 A; voltage meter stays at 12 V.

numbers.derive: count of panels in parallel (example set by PRD-20)
arithmetic: parallel keeps voltage at 12 V
arithmetic: 3 x 5 A = 15 A in parallel

fact_refs: Series adds voltage, parallel adds current
